news.headline: Terry McLaurin (knee) done for 2026 with torn patellar tendon
news.impact: McLaurin suffered the injury in the first half of Washington’s Monday Night game against San Fransisco, coming up lame after trying to run a route, and staying down for some time before being carted off. An MRI today confirmed the injury, and McLaurin will now miss the rest of 2026. Antonio Williams and Chig Okonkwo are now priority waiver pickups for those in need, and if you are in need of a name in deep leagues, Treylon Burks actually had a fair performance on Monday, though he is banged up as well, so his status will need to be monitored. Regardless, Williams and Okonkwo figure to see an uptick in work alongside Stefon Diggs.

news.impact: A report by Rapoport noted Hurts played in London with no sleep, as sleep was a risk for the QB.
